newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK INFLATION FALLS TO 5.4PCT Y/Y IN MAY.
newsitem.headline: GREEK INFLATION FALLS TO 5.4PCT Y/Y IN MAY.

text.p: Greek consumer price inflation fell to 5.4 percent year-on-year in May from 5.9 percent in April, the National Statistics Service (NSS) said in a statement.
The treatment of heating oil as a seasonal good for the
first time in May contributed to the deceleration of inflation,
Heating oil prices will not be affected by a tax hike that
goes into effect in May and will remain unchanged for the period
Higher heating oil prices added 0.6 percent month-on-month
to the consumer price inflation in May 1996, it said.
